//: TEMPLATE — copy this to appsettings.json and fill in the real secret values. appsettings.json is gitignored so secrets never get uploaded.

ConnectionStrings.//: PostgreSQL / Supabase. Either the postgresql:// URI from the dashboard or Npgsql key=value form. On IPv4-only networks use the Session Pooler host (aws-0-<region>.pooler.supabase.com), not db.<ref>.supabase.co which is IPv6-only.

Roles.//: Role given to NEW sign-ups. Allowed: 'Admin' (can upload + delete own songs) or 'User' (listen only). Anything else falls back to Admin. SuperAdmin is NEVER granted here — set it by hand in SQL: UPDATE Account SET Role='SuperAdmin' WHERE Email='you@example.com';

Youtube.//: YouTube import. Provider 'YtDlp' (recommended, robust) runs yt-dlp.exe; set YtDlpPath to its full path (download from https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases). Provider 'YoutubeExplode' is a pure-.NET fallback needing no binaries.
